review_setup_dependencies: review the setup.py INSTALL_REQUIRES dependencies for version conflicts or outdated packages
review_setup_extras: review the setup.py EXTRAS_REQUIRE test and quality dependency groups
review_setup_metadata: review the setup.py package metadata including name version description and classifiers
review_setup_version_extraction: review the setup.py version extraction logic that reads optimum/habana/version.py using regex
review_setup_package_config: review the setup.py find_namespace_packages configuration and include_package_data settings
